verdict.rationale: Avalara documents an official AvaTax MCP server, with a dedicated MCP docs page and an MCP servers listing that the probe confirmed. The docs list concrete tools covering tax calculation, transaction management, nexus handling, and AI tax-code recommendations, and the free trial explicitly covers AvaTax MCP servers. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent, and documented connection/auth/transport setup details in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Provides access to the Avalara AvaTax API for tax calculation, transaction management, nexus handling, and compliance data.
Integrate, test, and scale compliance with AvaTax MCP servers, Avalara Avi Agent and APIs using the 90-day AvaTax free trial
Provides AI-powered tax code recommendations for products. Returns 1 to 3 ranked tax code suggestions with confidence levels
